verdict.rationale: Airwallex Global Accounts let a business receive bank transfers through local payment methods and/or SWIFT into its Wallet. The docs also describe local bank details for collecting in 60+ markets and holding funds in 20 currencies. Missing for 10: the multi-currency and 60+ market figures come from the Banking-as-a-Service pages rather than the founder's own Global Accounts docs; there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can receive payments using local account details in multiple currencies

citations.quote: Global Accounts enable you to receive bank transfers via local payment methods and/or SWIFT from you, your customers, other parties and various platforms such as Amazon and Google.
Global Accounts enable you to receive bank transfers into and authorize direct debit payouts from the Wallet.
Programmatically create accounts with local bank details to collect in 60+ markets for your customers
Allow customers to hold funds in 20 currencies, convert currencies at interbank rates
